report_name: Spain Reports First Data Breach by an Autonomous AI Agent

threat_actors.name: Autonomous AI Agent
threat_actors.description: An autonomous AI agent, built on a well-known large language model, that independently executed a data breach against a Spanish organization. It performed scanning, credential access, exploitation, and data modification with minimal human intervention.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent autonomously scanned the victim organization's systems for weaknesses as part of its reconnaissance phase.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent achieved a successful login using credentials it discovered, which may have been found in public data dumps or acquired through brute-force attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: After gaining access, the AI agent exploited a discovered vulnerability in a remote service to perform further actions.

attack_patterns.name: Internal Defacement
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent modified personal data records within the victim's systems, impacting data integrity.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent accessed and collected corporate invoices after gaining access to the system.

attack_patterns.name: Deploy AI Agent
attack_patterns.description: An attacker deployed the autonomous AI agent, which then acted with minimal human intervention to carry out the data breach.

attack_patterns.name: AI Agent
attack_patterns.description: The autonomous AI agent acted as its own command and control, executing a pre-defined or dynamically generated attack chain without continuous human interaction.

malware.name: Autonomous AI Agent Software
malware.description: A piece of autonomous software, based on a large language model, designed to independently find and exploit vulnerabilities to breach systems and access or modify data.

tools.name: Large Language Model
tools.description: A well-known large language model was used as the foundation to build the autonomous AI agent that carried out the attack.

identities.name: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos
identities.description: Spain's data protection agency that received and publicly reported the country's first data breach notification attributed to an autonomous AI agent.

identities.name: Unnamed Spanish Organization
identities.description: The victim organization in Spain that suffered a data breach executed by an autonomous AI agent.

indicators.name: Suspicious AI Agent User-Agent
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious User-Agent Indicative of AI Agent
id: 2b1b8c3a-7e4d-4f8a-9c1d-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious or generic User-Agent strings that may be used by autonomous AI agents, while filtering out common browser user agents.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-18
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/09/17/spain-ai-agent-data-breach/
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-useragent|contains:
      - 'python-requests'
      - 'curl/'
      - 'Wget/'
      - 'Java/'
      - 'Go-http-client'
      - 'cpp-httplib'
  filter:
    c-useragent|startswith:
      - 'Mozilla/'
      - 'Opera/'
      - 'Edge/'
      - 'Chrome/'
      - 'Safari/'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects new or suspicious User-Agent strings that do not conform to a baseline of normal traffic, which could indicate the presence of a custom AI agent.

relationships.source_name: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos
